original: WPRPLACE is a waterfall in Gjesdal Municipality in Rogaland county, Norway. The 92 metre tall waterfall is located along the river Månaåna, about 6 kilometres east of the end of the Frafjorden where the village of Frafjord is located. The waterfall is in a fairly isolated area. There is a parking area nearby with a steep, rough 250 metres hiking trail up a mountainside to see the waterfall. The hike takes about 30 minutes.

Es gibt einen Parkplatz in der Nähe mit einem steilen, rauen 250 Meter Wanderweg einen Berg hinauf, um den Wasserfall zu sehen. Die Wanderung dauert ca. 30 Minuten.
